long_biography.plain_text:
Property owner Faber Tan was among the original board members of the Housing Industry Foundation. The organisation brought apartment owners, contractors and suppliers together to help households facing a housing crisis, combining emergency grants with work on local shelters. His volunteer contribution later earned its lifetime achievement award.

When Kepler's bookstore closed in Menlo Park, his family's Tan Group helped negotiate a new lease so it could reopen. The landlord made substantial concessions, while seeking assurance that the revised business could succeed. The town's mayor credited Tan and Joe Tan with helping reach the settlement; outside investors supplied separate rescue capital.
